items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Kimball was playing bass. ... Kimball was playing string bass. ... John Porter was playing suzer for me.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm getting back to something I meant to ask you about before. Who played before you were the Handys band? Do you know who the drummer was? Before I played? Yeah.
Roy Evans. He was in that band. Roy was in that band and Kimball, old man. Kimball was playing bass.
Mm-hmm. But you didn't play with Kimball then? In that band?
